ranked.headline: Interpretable genomic inference from annotation, prioritization and knowledge graphs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply evidence-linked enrichment, knowledge graphs and integrative scoring to disease gene and variant interpretation.

ranked.headline: Network and graph methods add functional context to transcriptomic and multiomic data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers embed gene and protein measurements in graphs, programs, and enrichment networks to aid interpretation.

ranked.headline: Computational models infer cell states and perturbation responses from single-cell data
ranked.summary: New foundation models and transport-based predictors extend single-cell inference to perturbation, spatial and bulk settings.

ranked.headline: Biological foundation models assessed for transfer, weight security, and self-supervision
ranked.summary: Released biological models are now tested beyond their training setting: cross-species variants, weight-attack resistance, and predictive objectives.

ranked.headline: Web servers for pocket flexibility, structure search, partial charges and peptide modeling
ranked.summary: Several web servers published 2026-07-11 extend pocket prioritisation over structural ensembles to broader structure search and property tools.

ranked.headline: Calibrated and reference-free corrections for RNA-seq transcript measurements
ranked.summary: Recent preprints calibrate or replace read-derived transcript estimates using orthogonal validation or reference-free k-mer methods.

ranked.headline: Pretrained protein encoders underpin interpretable binding and property prediction
ranked.summary: Multimodal protein foundation models are being profiled for allosteric versus orthosteric site detection, with ablations and variance analysis.

ranked.headline: Quantitative descriptors and sampled landscapes now drive sequence and peptide design
ranked.summary: Normalized sequence descriptors and free-energy analyses are now coupled directly to designing disordered polypeptides, cyclic peptides, and mutants.

ranked.headline: Distance priors and geometry descriptors for protein and RNA structure analysis
ranked.summary: Structure predictors and RNA geometry encodings are now treated as tunable inputs and quantitative readouts rather than only output coordinates.

ranked.headline: Structure predictors extended to non-natural peptide chemistry and interaction tools
ranked.summary: PEPstrMOD2 extends AlphaFold2 and ESMFold to 928 modifications, and several new web servers package learned models for binding and site prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational tools map microbial functions and phage genomes from metagenomic data
ranked.summary: Recent tools extend metagenome analysis to phage assembly, glycoside hydrolase detection in unassembled reads, and functional trait prediction.

ranked.headline: Read-level models infer cell types, cancer, and drug response from genomic reads
ranked.summary: Foundation and language models trained on DNA fragments and cfRNA reads now extend read-level inference to cancer detection and cell typing.

ranked.headline: Models infer site-level and protein-level properties from existing measurements
ranked.summary: Reprocessed public datasets and provenance-aware resources are now paired with new model development and benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Pretrained biological models adapted to perturbation, drug response and spatial tasks
ranked.summary: Fine-tuning scGPT on LINCS L1000 profiles and transferring BERT and graph encoders now yields perturbation, drug response, and spatial embeddings.

ranked.headline: Learned models span enzyme stability, specificity, and sequence design
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and new architectures test whether sequence-only or fused structure-sequence models best predict stability, specificity, and enzyme design.

ranked.headline: Protein inclusions and condensates perturb lipid bilayer thickness and packing
ranked.summary: Multiscale simulation, SAXS and condensate MD now quantify how embedded proteins and condensates strain and couple to bilayers.

ranked.headline: Indexed, compressed formats enable subgraph queries on pangenome graphs and alignments
ranked.summary: Shredtools answers coordinate queries across 476 human genomes, and GBZ-base and GAF-base enable disk-based subgraph access to pangenome data.

ranked.headline: LLM multi-agent frameworks automate bioinformatics analysis and literature mining
ranked.summary: Recent preprints report agentic LLM systems executing single-cell, spatial, PKPD/PBPK, and literature-mining workflows with framework-level evidence.

ranked.headline: Deep networks infer molecular and cellular state from images and sequences
ranked.summary: Self-supervised and deep models are now applied across microscopy, pathology, spatial transcriptomics, and protein sequences for molecular inference.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware models predict peptide and macrocycle target engagement and permeability
ranked.summary: Learned models now couple conformational and activity scoring with generative design and iterative screening for peptides and antibiotics.

ranked.headline: Computational methods extract structural and somatic variation from sequencing data
ranked.summary: New methods extract rDNA copy number, isoforms, somatic mutations and cfDNA fragmentation from long-read, short-read and single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Constraints steer generative design of small molecules and antibodies
ranked.summary: Recent 2026 preprints move target conditioning and developability checks into design loops rather than applying them only after generation.

ranked.headline: Correction and benchmarking of RNA sequencing and structure tool outputs
ranked.summary: Long-read RNA and tRNA sequencing pipelines and RNA structure servers now add explicit correction or integrated analysis before biological interpretation.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-resolved long-read assemblies expand eukaryotic reference genomes
ranked.summary: Chromosome-scale reference genomes now span insects, protists, a fungal isolate and all 25 Aegilops species, enabling direct comparative analysis.

ranked.headline: Spatial context guides inference of molecular and tissue features across scales
ranked.summary: Recent spatially aware methods infer, translate and simulate tissue-scale molecular features rather than only describing them.

ranked.headline: Connectivity structure and plasticity rules set what networks learn and retain
ranked.summary: Recent work links Hebbian plasticity strength, spiking connectivity, and predictive feedback asymmetry to measurable performance outcomes.

ranked.headline: Community-scale tools extract function and chimeras from unassembled metagenomic data
ranked.summary: Tools operating on raw or unassembled community data now target chimera detection, rRNA handling, and pangenome-aware nanopore mapping.

ranked.headline: Kinetics-guided Cas9 fidelity and computational CRISPR guide and knock-in design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend computational CRISPR design to nuclease kinetic fidelity and precision knock-in reagent selection.

ranked.headline: Reinforcement learning now guides molecular generation and adaptive cancer dosing
ranked.summary: Three July 2026 items apply reinforcement learning to molecular generation and dosing, with the dosing study benchmarked against fixed schedules.

ranked.headline: Continuum and geometry-aware models link mechanics and geometry to spatial tissue dynamics
ranked.summary: Mechanistic formulations now couple growth, mechanics, geometry, and dynamical law across scales from cell monolayers to tissue morphology.

ranked.headline: Computational decoding of chromatin accessibility, cell-cycle occupancy and UV damage
ranked.summary: Single-nucleus and cell-cycle-resolved chromatin datasets now support genotype- and cell-state-aware epigenomic inference.

ranked.headline: Browser-based tools for viral contig discovery, primer design and genomic analysis
ranked.summary: Recent web servers and conda-installable resources package viral contig and RdRp discovery alongside primer and genomic analysis for molecular biologists.

ranked.headline: Web servers now expose ensemble, folding-delay, and energy-network analyses of proteins
ranked.summary: Published web servers now package SAXS fitting, translational folding delays, and energy networks for structural analysis.

ranked.headline: Deep learning and single-cell profiling resolve tissue and cell-state heterogeneity
ranked.summary: Computational tools now quantify tumor microenvironment composition, wound cell states, and time-lapse cell interactions at scale.

ranked.headline: Models infer cell fate, clonal fitness, and tissue patterning from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial data now feed explicit models that infer fate bias, tumor cell fitness, and skeletal patterning.

ranked.headline: Predictive accuracy in single-cell and dynamical models can mask unrecovered structure
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether fitted digital twins and bases recover structure beyond predictive accuracy, with explicit representational and recovery limits.

ranked.headline: Hierarchical models infer temporal processing hierarchies from human neural data
ranked.summary: Temporal processing hierarchies in human cortex are being resolved at individual and regional levels using hierarchical Bayesian and multimodal neuroimaging.

ranked.headline: Transposon turnover and sex-linked loci shape comparative genome structure
ranked.summary: Multi-genome analyses of moss and Hermetia illucens assemblies now resolve lineage-specific sex linkage and transposable element turnover at comparative scale.

ranked.headline: Computational models probe methylation memory, enzyme mechanisms and protein states
ranked.summary: Predictive and benchmarking frameworks now address epigenetic information capacity, polar enzyme mechanisms and multi-state protein structure bias.

ranked.headline: Models infer hidden hemodynamic and molecular states from imaging data
ranked.summary: Label-free and coregistered imaging now pairs with physics-informed or trained models to estimate quantities that are not directly measured.
